name: Cancer
description: The Crab is the faintest of the zodiacal constellations, but its open cluster Praesepe (the Beehive) is one of the nearest star clusters to Earth. It also hosts 55 Cancri, a nearby star system with five confirmed planets including a potential 'super-Earth' that was once described as possibly diamond-rich.
funFact: 55 Cancri e, the innermost planet orbiting the star at only 0.015 AU, completes a full orbit in just 17.7 hours and was once theorised to be a carbon-rich world where conditions might allow diamond to be stable at depth. More recent studies favour a volatile-rich composition, but it remains one of the best-studied super-Earths.
